item.title: Every Stock I'm Buying Right Now Before 2026 Ends (7 Unthinkable Prices)
item.description:
I'm buying 7 stocks to beat the market's Magnificent 7. And... these stocks have a massive amount of upside opportunity over the next decade. Over a year ago, I ran the real Mag 7 (Meta, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Nvidia, Apple, and Tesla) through our stock analyzer using reasonable assumptions. The expected 10-year returns just did not impress me. Most were priced for perfection. Tesla, by my math, was looking at negative returns over a decade.
So I built a different list back at the start of 2025: 7 companies with better valuations, and stronger long-term potential. and I'm going to share with you the price I would pay for each of them.
$ULTA, $NKE, $SFM, $PYPL, $ADBE, $LUV, $BABA

item.title: 3 Stocks to Buy & (3 Stocks to Sell) Before October Ends
item.description:
Some of the hottest, most exciting stocks in the market right now are the ones you should be most careful with. And some of the most boring? They might be the real buys. Today I've got 3 stocks worth buying according to Forbes and 3 worth selling based on recent Morningstar reports. And get this: one of the sells has revenue up 372%.
Yes, you heard that right. A company growing that fast, and it's on the sell list. We are going to break it all down and run each one through our Everything Money process for you. And by the end, you'll know the one mistake that can turn a great company into a terrible investment.

item.title: If You’re an Uber Shareholder… Get Ready! (Massive Upside Potential)
item.description:
Uber’s stock has been crushed — down almost 31% from its high. And yet, just days ago, something happened that should grab every shareholder’s attention: Uber’s own CEO walked into the market and bought $10 million of Uber stock with his OWN money. Six days before that, another top executive bought $5.3 million. And some of the biggest investors on Wall Street have been piling in too. So what do they see that everyone else is missing? Because there’s one giant question hanging over this stock: are robotaxis about to DESTROY Uber… or turn it into one of the biggest winners of the entire self-driving revolution?

item.title: I Can’t Believe How Cheap These Mega Cap Stocks Are Right Now (Near a 52 week low)
item.description:
Everybody SAYS they want to buy great companies when they're cheap. Right now, 3 of the most recognizable, most durable businesses in all of America are trading at, or just a hair above, their 52 week lows. McDonald's has fallen more than 27% from its high. Aon is down over 20%. And American Express is getting hammered even while its revenue grows double digits.
So today we're going to figure out whether the market just handed us 3 incredible opportunities… or 3 sneaky value traps. And I'm going to tell you ahead of time — when we run the numbers, things get VERY interesting. Let's dig in.

item.title: The Next Historic Financial Crisis Is Already Here
item.description:
If the next great financial crisis has already begun… it probably doesn’t look like one yet. The stock market is still near record highs. Unemployment is only 4.1%. People are still out shopping. But... underneath that calm surface, something extraordinary is happening.
A key interest rate just crossed 5% for the first time since 2007. Mortgages are back above 7%. America’s banks are sitting on over $326 billion in losses. Oil is above $100.
And this week, the Federal Reserve did something it hasn’t done in over three years — it RAISED interest rates. Now, does that mean another 2008 is coming? There are some very interesting things happening underneath the surface right now that every investor needs to understand. So today, we’re going down the rabbit hole.

item.title: Is Value Investing Dead?
item.description:
Is value investing dead? Everyone keeps saying it is. And after today, you're going to understand exactly why they're saying it — why they're partly right — and the one thing they're getting completely, dangerously wrong. Because here's what nobody talks about. The investors who've used this approach — Buffett, Munger, Ackman, Klarman — exposed some of the greatest track records in the history of the stock market. We're talking about math and how a thousand dollars turned into sixty-one million. Not with options. Not with day trading. Not with some algorithm. With patience and a process. So stick with me, because this changes how you should look at every stock you own.

item.title: Inside Wall Street's Brand New $500 Billion "Ponzi Scheme"
item.description:
I want to read you something.
This is a comment on a YouTube video. Not my video. A video with millions of views. And this comment got almost three thousand likes.
"Markets are a full-on Ponzi. The entire monetary system is a Ponzi."
Three thousand likes. Almost two hundred replies. And when you read through those replies, it's not trolls. It's regular investors. People with 401ks. People putting money in every single month.
And they're looking at what's happening right now with AI and saying — something doesn't add up. So I decided to trace where the money actually goes.
Nvidia just helped set up a brand new 500 billion dollar lending facility with Wall Street. And when I followed the money — step by step — from who's lending it to who's borrowing it to where it ends up — I understood why those three thousand people hit the like button.
Michael Burry sees it. Ray Dalio sees it. Mark Cuban sees it. Steve Eisman sees it. And by the end of this video, you're going to see it too.
But I'm also going to give you something none of them gave you — a framework to protect yourself no matter which way this goes.

item.title: The UNTHINKABLE Is About To Happen To Stocks
item.description:
If you've been watching the market these last few days and thinking something feels off, I don't think you're wrong.
But I want to show you something I don't think most people have picked up on. Because right now, this market is telling you 2 completely opposite things at the exact same time.
On one side, you've got oil back over $100 a barrel, the bond market falling apart, and traders bracing for the Fed to actually raise rates. That's about as scared as this market gets.
And on the other side, in that same market, on that same day, money is pouring into junk bonds. Private equity guys are outbidding each other for dirt. Investors are chasing yield like nothing is wrong at all.
Fear and greed. Same market. Same week. And guys, when you see those 2 things happening at once, that is one of the most important signals you will ever learn to read.
So I'm going to walk you through exactly what's happening and why it matters. And then at the end of this video, I'm going to show you the one business I have the most conviction in right now. But I'm going to show you my work on it before I tell you whether I'm buying it. Because I want you to judge the analysis before you judge the position.

item.title: This Only Happens Once Every Decade
item.description:
The $2 trillion software crash wiped out massive market value, but it also created a rare once-in-a-decade opportunity.
In early 2026, investor fear triggered a massive software crash that looked eerily similar to the dot-com bubble. Trillions of dollars in market value evaporated in a matter of weeks, causing panic across the industry. Yet, the story did not end there. Many of the hardest-hit software stocks experienced a dramatic recovery shortly after the initial sell-off, with some investors seeing gains of over 76% in a very short window.
This video breaks down how that market downturn actually unfolded and what it means for your portfolio. We analyze why the initial sell-off happened, how to identify when a sector is oversold, and the specific indicators that signaled the eventual stock market recovery. If you are looking to understand how to navigate high-volatility environments without emotional trading, this analysis is for you.
Subscribe for weekly investing breakdowns, and let me know in the comments if you think tech stocks are still overvalued right now.
